description: Agent Observability: submit an agent’s logging design, a sample of its log, or both: the design as whether each record names the actor, the principal and the authorization behind the action, holds the step’s inputs and outputs and carries a timestamp; each sample entry with its id, time, action, kind (a read, a write, a payment, a message, a tool call, a decision or other), actor, principal, authorization and its recorded inputs and outputs; and optionally the grants, mandates and approvals on file. The signed report says field by field what the design promises and what the entries hold, and names what an audit would need and not find: which actor took each action, the authorization behind it, and the inputs and the outputs of each step; then records with no principal or timestamp, shared actors such as system or agent that name no one actor, authorizations not on file and a design the sample log does not follow, with the fix for each. Whether each step of one run names its actor is wever_actor-attribution-check, whether an approval record holds up is wever_approval-record-check and a counterparty’s SOC 2 or ISO audit report is wever_audit-evidence-check. Verdict audit_blind, log_gaps, log_unverified or audit_ready. POST /api/observability-log-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-observability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-observability/.

authorizations.description: The grants, mandates and approvals on file, by id.

authorization.description: Each record names the grant, mandate or approval behind the action.

input.description: Each record holds the inputs of its step.

output.description: Each record holds the outputs of its step.

principal.description: Each record names the principal the action was taken for.

entries.description: A sample of the log, entry by entry.

action.description: What was done, such as issue refund.

actor.description: Who took it, such as support-agent-2.

authorization.description: The grant, mandate or approval behind it, such as approval A-17.

input.description: What the step was given, as recorded.

kind.description: A read, a write, a payment, a message, a tool call, a decision or other.

output.description: What the step returned, as recorded.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
